title: Angels & Saints: choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Kurus at the Village Gate. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Kurus at the Village Gate
options.lineage: Vasai / East Indian wayside crosses: limewashed, indigo-trimmed, marigold-garlanded, lamp-lit
options.thesis: Today is a painted plaque at the village gate: the date, the feast, the Word, garlanded fresh each morning.
options.viewport: Today tab: huge signpainted day numeral and season on chalk-white, an indigo-ruled plaque with the feast, then reading plates I–IV; marigold marks only what is live today.
options.risk: Regional: Catholics outside the Vasai/Mumbai belt read it as Indian-devotional rather than recognising the crosses; signpaint type goes kitsch if overused beyond display.

raised.raise: Every reading is a fixed-anatomy plate (number, kind, reference, text) on one shared baseline, identical every day.
A folded marigold flag marks where you stopped reading; it persists and re-flags on return.
The date strip keeps neighbouring days as ghosted numerals; today is struck forward in marigold.
Liturgical season is a named phase with its own trim pattern, never colour alone.

options.label: Missal Rubrics
options.lineage: the altar Missal and Lectionary: black text, red rubrics, silk ribbon markers
options.thesis: Say the black, do the red: the app is set like the book on the altar.
options.viewport: Today opens as a Lectionary page: red rubric heading, black readings, a ribbon in the season colour hanging from the top edge.
options.risk: Cream + serif + red is exactly where most runs in this category land; it can look like every other missal app.

options.label: Cyclorama Dawn
options.lineage: theatre cyclorama lighting, night to day
options.thesis: The app's light follows the day: night-black for Compline, cobalt and rose at dawn, white at Mass.
options.viewport: Today screen as horizon bands from dark to light, the reading you are on in the brightest band.
options.case: Holds product clarity (the daily ritual and dark/light map cleanly) but the audience has no tie to stage lighting.
options.risk: Atmosphere over legibility if the bands carry long Marathi text.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.thesis: The liturgical year as one plant through its seasons.
options.case: Loses both axes: no audience tie, and the metaphor needs explaining.
options.kept: Fixed-anatomy plates on a shared baseline.

options.label: Cutting Bench
options.thesis: Readings strung along a perforated rail.
options.viewport: A select rail with frames per reading.
options.case: Loses both axes: an editor's tool, not a devotional object.
options.kept: The folded flag where you stopped.

options.label: Struck Cathode
options.thesis: Every date present as a ghost; today struck in orange.
options.viewport: Ghosted numeral stack with today lit.
options.case: Loses both axes: techno-nostalgia against a reverent brief.
options.kept: Neighbouring days as ghosts, today struck forward.

options.label: Garden Guide Map
options.thesis: Library sections as swelling colour lobes.
options.case: Loses both axes: playful register fights reverence.
options.kept: Total commitment to flat colour fields.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A Catholic Material 3 app done right: burgundy and gold, tonal surfaces, saint artwork cards.
canonCard.viewport: Today card stack: feast card with art, readings cards, bottom nav.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from Laudate, Hallow-lite and every parish app.
